title: pre.style package.json field
description: The "pre.style" field in package.json. In an app, it holds the options every tool that reads the project's styles shares. In a component library, it marks the package as a library for apps to compile.

prependFiles.description: Files added to the start of every block and stylesheet file, for custom properties, Sass variables, and mixins. An array applies to both languages; `css` and `scss` apply to one. Relative to the package.

css.description: Files added to the start of every css block and .css stylesheet file.

scss.description: Files added to the start of every scss block and .scss stylesheet file.

include.description: Globs of the library's files with blocks, relative to the package. Defaults to every JS, TS, and Astro file.

keyframeLocalization.description: Give each @keyframes in the library's blocks and stylesheet files a generated name, used only in the block or file that defines it, like styled-components' `keyframes`. The app's setting doesn't apply to libraries.

anyOf.description: A component library compiled with the default settings.

include.description: Globs of every source file with blocks, relative to the package. Scanned before a build to assign names. Defaults to every JS, TS, HTML, and Astro file.

keyframeLocalization.description: Give each @keyframes in the app's blocks and stylesheet files a generated name, used only in the block or file that defines it (including keyframes from prepended files), like styled-components' `keyframes`. Libraries use their own setting.

libraries.description: App only. Component libraries to compile, by package name, in addition to dependencies with a "pre.style" field. A config replaces the package's field, `true` uses the defaults, and `false` leaves the package out.

quirksMode.description: App only. You probably don't want this: lowercase class names only, for pages in quirks mode (no doctype). Names get longer.
